name: Route-Depth Signature (measured)

source_evidence.data: NFL BDB 2025 tracking (real 10Hz), weeks 1 (train n=813) and 7 (held-out n=709) targeted receivers

mechanism_text: Deep routes (GO/POST/CORNER/WHEEL) are distinguishable from short routes by the receiver's kinematic signature alone: they are run at higher top speed, released from tighter press, and carry their speed to the arrival point. The tracking signature precedes the ball's arrival, so the classification is available pre-throw.

magnitude_ladder.condition: speed_max > 8.5 m/s AND sep_min > 1.0 m (clean release)
speed_max < 5.5 m/s AND sep_min < 0.9 m (press trail)

falsifiers: held-out AUC drops below 0.65 on a second week split (week 8 replication)
coefficients flip sign on the replication split (mechanism unstable)
the feature set fails to beat the context prior's log-loss when blended at w=0.5
use_in_decision: SHADOW — weight 0 until the falsifier's full validation spec crosses
honesty_note: Two independent week splits (7, 8) both exceed the pre-registered AUC bar; the mechanism is stable across samples. Still SHADOW weight-0: measured signal quality is necessary but not sufficient — the full validation spec (calibration half + market half on the same margin) governs the flip.

composition_note.result: NO interaction — the kinematic signature is coverage-agnostic
composition_note.doctrine: primitives compose only when effects touch the same mechanism; the cover-tier path was tested and does not touch this mechanism

third_criterion.test: family blend (w=0.5 pre-registered) vs context prior, held-out tracked plays n=1429 (wk7+8)

gate_progress.calibration_half: dry-run PASSED on real data (this artifact + falsifier-dryrun-real.json)
gate_progress.family_model: AUC 0.846 wk7 / 0.879 wk8, blend delta +0.0377 held-out
gate_progress.market_half: PENDING — per-play market margin comparison needs the game-margin rollout
gate_progress.final_flip: STILL weight-0: both halves on the SAME margin required by VISION-CONTRACT

market_half.status: MEASURED — location improves marginally, width claim FAILS out-of-fold
market_half.verdict: MARKET HALF NOT MET: the contract requires strictly smaller uncertainty; out-of-fold the width edge vanishes. The EPA deltas add real but tiny location skill.

injury_extension.tested: Out/Doubtful counts by position group (OL/QB/WR/RB/TE/DEF), 2015-24 injuries releases, joined pre-game
findings: injury counts WIDEN the model (B worst) — raw counts are noise at this granularity
A (EPA-only) edges the market on location (3.9575 < 3.9589) but fails the width half (13.369 > 13.319)
suspicious coefficients (RB -12.5) flag count-feature instability — role-weighted availability is the next granularity
injury_extension.verdict: MARKET HALF STILL NOT MET — both halves recorded; availability data does not break the collinearity at count granularity
